message.content: {"title":"Population & Property Dynamics","narrative":"The model begins with 150 Person agents concentrated in Room 1, connected via a 1.2 m doorway to a corridor and then to Room 2 and an exit. The specification notes this narrow door functions as a bottleneck, intended to localize congestion upstream (zone‐1) relative to downstream (zone‐2).\n\nNo aggregated time‐series of agent counts, per‐step evacuated_count, or zone occupancies were provided in the evidence. Consequently, it is not possible to quantify evacuation phases, identify oscillations or tipping points, or measure the rate at which agents transition between zones or exit the environment.","key_findings":["Initial population of 150 agents located entirely in Room 1 at simulation start (step 0).","1.2 m door between Room 1 and corridor serves as the primary flow‐limiting bottleneck, expected to produce zone‐1 congestion ≫ zone‐2.","Absence of provided time series (evacuated_count, zone occupancies) precludes quantitative analysis of evacuation dynamics."],"causal_links":[],"emergent_phenomena":[]}
